messages.author: c46ff825b47e08c9
messages.subject: POSTing with Content-Type other than 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' causes segfault
parts:
Hi, all:

Is it a known issue (using rapache 1.2.0) that accessing the POST
variable causes a segfault if the Content-Type of the POST is
something other than 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'? (I can
submit a reproduction if need be.)

Regards,

Nick

messages.author: c46ff825b47e08c9
messages.subject: Re: POSTing with Content-Type other than 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' causes segfault
parts:
On Sep 11, 2:10 pm, Jeffrey Horner <jeffrey.hor...@vanderbilt.edu>
wrote:

> On Tue, Sep 11, 2012 at 2:53 PM, ndro...@gmail.com <ndro...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > Hi, all:
>
> > Is it a known issue (using rapache 1.2.0) that accessing the POST
> > variable causes a segfault if the Content-Type of the POST is
> > something other than 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'?  (I can
> > submit a reproduction if need be.)
>
> Note that all the examples in the test directory use
> "multipart/form-data" and they work perfectly.
>
> Can you provide a reproducible example?

Try this.

Apache config (minus the LoadModule directive):

<Location /reproduction>
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/reproduction.R::controller
</Location>

And reproduction.R:

controller <- function() {
setContentType("text/plain")
if (SERVER$method == "GET") {
cat("Handled GET")
return(DONE)
} else if (SERVER$method == "POST") {
if (is.null(POST)) { # <-- this condition causes a
segfault when Content-Type is not 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
write("Content-Type is not 'application/x-www-form-
urlencoded'", stderr())
}
cat("Handled POST")
return(DONE)
} else {
return(HTTP_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED)
}
}

Regards,

Nick
